compatibility_about: Project-authored reusable geometry. Asset coordinates are 0–100; currentColor comes from the scene palette. Human shapes are blocking silhouettes, not approved likenesses.

ant.description: The edition’s authored ant figure: three body lobes, six jointed legs and two antennae. A disclosed visual convention, never evidence of agent bodies.
ant.name: Ant

versions.note: Original storyboard component, preserved without changes.

apache-ant-logo.description: The existing embedded Apache Ant logo used on the creator’s tooling surface; a document mark rather than an agent character.
apache-ant-logo.name: Apache ant logo

aperture.description: A mechanical inspection aperture for a grader or observer. It must not read as a human eye or imply omniscient access.
aperture.name: Aperture
